title: Research audit: maximal invariant compact-control guard with saturated digits
body:
Saturated temporary digits can be safe for one earlier-source compact-control call and fail on the next. This audit derives the exact complete-map agreement set and its largest subset invariant under the intended XOR, with an explicit carry predicate and exact all-n transfer counts.

At `n=2,K=6,G=2`, the invariant good fraction is **1499/2048**, versus PR1219's **567/1024**. The full agreement fraction is `6841/8192`, but that set is not invariant and cannot be used blindly as the current-address repair guard. The retained construction and predecessor guards are correct.

**Mathematical audit / research note; no new kappa.** Only `research/compact-saturation-audit-seed69/` is added. The source word, production predicates, selected result and `upstream/` are unchanged.

The written proof covers `n>=1,G>=1,K>=G+1,0<=rho<K`. It retains all four swaps, four rotations, highest-bit completion and the complete exceptional-repair charge. Maximality applies to invariant agreement guards for this fixed word and complete rectangle, not every repair method.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/compact-saturation-audit-seed69
```

Expected: `PASS_COMPACT_SATURATION_AUDIT states=1196544 physical=1536 controls=7 headline=1499/2048 no_new_kappa`, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.

Verification covers all 1,196,544 quotient states in six domains, 38,080 carry-transition cases, every permutation/inverse and sorted repair payload, plus 1,536 original physical-interpreter comparisons. Seven mathematical controls run in the committed verifier. Eight algorithm corruptions, six source corruptions and two receipt corruptions were also rejected locally. Python 3.14.8, optimized 3.12.15 and optimized 3.11.15 agree; 17 existing compact-control tests, five selected-record tests and selected integrity pass. Finite replay supports the all-n written proof; it is not formal verification of the multiplication theorem.

Research base: `410026dc5513b87db92ae98571d1d5984c69a983`. Refreshed main: `4040a0f46d67b41c36a472a7cd4af791fd4c36cc`, with all inputs and applicable rules unchanged. OS assignment seed69 selected the adversarial-audit track. Exact SHA256/Git pins, the local claim, completed coverage and open next questions are included. The final overlap snapshot covers 828 open PRs, 162 discussion records and 328 local records; no matching saturation/invariance audit was found.

Credit Douglas Colkitt and OpenAI's original framework, Hanson Sun / bbMisk's PR1219 and adjacent PR1247, and @martinxxx9's PR1108. The new scope removes PR1219's nonsaturation restriction and follows compact carries across multiple digits. No pending implementation is imported. Prepared by Sagar Thakrar with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0; no independent human review.

Full selected cold replay, Linux, physical/tape/hosting admission and Lean were not run. Later-source composition and inherited compiler, precision and analytic obligations remain open. Hosted CI success is not asserted. Review should focus on PROOF.md Sections 2-4 and the distinction between agreement and an invariant repair guard.
